knowledgePoints.title: 一、读音规则
knowledgePoints.content: 在英语中，后缀-s的读音及拼写规则主要取决于它所附加单词的最后一个音素。具体如下：

subPoints.title: [s]音
subPoints.content:
当单词以清辅音（[p], [t], [k], [f], [θ]）结尾时，-s读作[s]。如：
- cats [kæts]
- books [bʊks]
- laughs [læfs]
- paths [pæθs]

subPoints.title: [z]音
subPoints.content:
当单词以浊辅音（[b], [d], [g], [v], [ð], [m], [n], [ŋ], [l], [r]）或元音（[ɑː], [ɔː], [ɜː], [iː], [uː], [ɪ], [e], [æ], [ʊ], [ə], [eɪ], [aɪ], [ɔɪ], [aʊ], [əʊ]）结尾时，-s读作[z]。如：
- dogs [dɒɡz]
- cars [kɑːrz]
- boys [bɔɪz]
- trees [triːz]

subPoints.title: [ɪz]音
subPoints.content:
当单词以咝音或破擦音（[s], [z], [ʃ], [ʒ], [tʃ], [dʒ]）结尾时，-s读作[ɪz]。如：
- buses [ˈbʌsɪz]
- boxes [ˈbɒksɪz]
- dishes [ˈdɪʃɪz]
- churches [ˈtʃɜːrtʃɪz]

subPoints.title: 直接加-s
subPoints.content:
大多数情况下，直接在单词末尾加-s。如：
book → books，dog → dogs，day → days，like → likes

subPoints.title: 加-es
subPoints.content:
当单词以-s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z结尾时，加-es。如：
bus → buses，dish → dishes，watch → watches，box → boxes，buzz → buzzes
例外：stomach → stomachs

subPoints.title: 以y结尾的单词
subPoints.content:
当单词以"辅音字母+ y"结尾时，变y为i，再加 -es。如：
baby → babies，city → cities，lady → ladies，family → families，carry → carries
当单词以"元音字母+y"结尾时，直接在词尾加-s。如：
boy → boys，toy → toys

subPoints.title: 以o结尾的单词
subPoints.content:
当单词以"元音字母+ o"结尾时，直接在词尾加-s。如：
radio → radios，zoo → zoos
当单词以"辅音字母+ o"结尾时，通常加-es。如：
tomato → tomatoes，potato → potatoes，hero → heroes
例外：photo → photos，piano → pianos，kilo → kilos

subPoints.title: 以-f或-fe结尾的单词
subPoints.content:
大多数单词需要将-f或-fe变为-v，然后加-es。如：
leaf → leaves，knife → knives，wolf → wolves，wife → wives，half → halves
例外：roof → roofs，belief → beliefs，chef → chefs，proof → proofs，chief → chiefs
两种形式均可，如：scarf → scarves或scarfs，wharf → wharves或wharfs

subPoints.title: 不规则变化的名词
subPoints.content:
man → men，woman → women，Englishman → Englishmen，Frenchman → Frenchmen
foot → feet，tooth → teeth，goose → geese，mouse → mice
analysis → analyses，basis → bases，crisis → crises
child → children，ox → oxen
bacterium →bacteria，criterion → criteria，medium → media，phenomenon → phenomena
sheep → sheep，deer → deer，fish(鱼) → fish，bison(野牛) → bison，species → species，series → series，means → means，aircraft → aircraft，Chinese → Chinese，Japanese → Japanese，Swiss → Swiss

subPoints.title: 三、合成名词的复数
subPoints.content:
一般将中心名词变复数，如：
girl friend → girl friends，passer-by → passers-by，son-in-law → sons-in-law
没有中心名词，则最后一个词变复数，如：
grown-up → grown-ups
man和woman +名词组成的合成名词，两个词都变复数，如：
man doctor → men doctors，woman driver → women drivers

exercises.question: Dancing and skating are my __________ (hobby), and I also like to read short __________ (story).
exercises.explanation: hobby以辅音字母+y结尾，变y为i加es；story也是以辅音字母+y结尾，变y为i加es。

exercises.question: The library, which is known for its vast collection of __________ (book) on various subjects, also offers access to historical __________ (document).
Susan Luo, an adviser for __________ (teenager), has received a letter asking for some __________ (advise).
exercises.explanation: teenager以er结尾，直接加s；advice是不可数名词，不加s。

exercises.question: You think that your friend __________ (play) computer games too often and __________ (spend) too much time online.
exercises.explanation: play以辅音字母+y结尾，变y为i加es；spend以s结尾，直接加s。

exercises.question: One of the most pressing __________ (issue) is the excessive use of plastic __________ (product), which often end up in our oceans, harming marine __________ (life).
exercises.explanation: issue以e结尾，直接加s；product以t结尾，直接加s；life以fe结尾，变fe为ves。

exercises.question: This four-day walking tour will take you on amazing __________ (path) through the Andes Mountains on the way to the city of Machu Picchu.
Instead of saying "I want to lose three __________ (kilo)", I would say "I want to run two __________ (kilometre) in eight __________ (minute)" or "I want to be able to do 30 __________ (push-up)".
exercises.explanation: kilo以o结尾但以元音字母+o结尾，直接加s；kilometre以re结尾，直接加s；minute以e结尾，直接加s；push-up是合成名词，没有中心名词，最后一个词变复数。

exercises.question: __________ (mouse) ran out of the fields looking for places to hide, and __________ (fish) jumped out of the water.
exercises.explanation: mouse是不规则变化，mouse → mice；fish是单复数同形。

exercises.question: These ice __________ (prince) and __________ (princess) are so graceful that it's easy to forget that they are actually highly skilled __________ (athlete).
exercises.explanation: prince以ce结尾，直接加s；princess以ss结尾，加es；athlete以e结尾，直接加s。

exercises.question: After that, Tim started looking for new __________ (language) to learn, and posting more __________ (video) of himself speaking new __________ (language), including Chinese.
exercises.explanation: language以e结尾，直接加s；video以o结尾但以元音字母+o结尾，直接加s。
